newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Monday mixed against hard currencies after a lacklustre interbank trading session, dealers said.
"Not much happened today. It was a rather dull market, I'm afraid," one dealer commented.
Dealers said the market had turned a blind eye to an on-going strike by junior doctors and nurses demanding better pay and working conditions.
"Our kind of market really does not respond to such occurances," one said.
The local unit finished the day at 10.6400/6600 against the U.S. dollar, where it closed last Friday, but eased to 7.0700/0900 from 7.0460/0610 versus the mark.
It was however firmer against pound sterling at 17.5200/5400 from 17.5510/5950 and at 2.2600/2800 against the rand compared to 2.2630/2710.
